description: Shared fixture for the prompt/skill-catalog parity probe. Read by BOTH sides: go_hive/scripts/prompt_catalog_render.py (Python reference) and go_hive/go-hive/internal/skills/catalog_prompt_parity_test.go (Go target). Each profile is materialized as a temp HIVE_HOME + HOME pair so discovery, ordering, description capping and the compact fallback are exercised end to end. Symlinks (symlink-view -> symlink-target) cover Path.resolve() location parity.
